sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Evaluates the current state of security capabilities across organizational and technical dimensions. Uses maturity models to benchmark against industry standards. Covers governance, processes, tools, and culture. Provides a baseline for roadmap development. Typically includes visual dashboards and prioritized recommendations. Often included in strategy assignments.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Gives customers a clear understanding of strengths and weaknesses. Enables targeted improvements and resource allocation. Supports strategic planning and transformation alignment. Enhances internal awareness and accountability. Provides measurable progress tracking over time.

sections.heading: Related Guidelines & Tools
items: Standard approach available, including templates for assessment, reporting & proposing
